personal_details.name: Shaik Mohammed Bilal
personal_details.title: Senior AI & Full Stack Developer
personal_details.points_to_user:
To excel in the interview for this Senior AI & Full Stack Developer role, you should focus on deepening your expertise in the following areas, based on the modifications made to your resume:

1.  **LangGraph and Agentic Workflows**: Review the core concepts of state machines, conditional edges, and multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph. Be prepared to discuss how you design complex, multi-step workflows for document processing and chatbots.
2.  **LlamaIndex for Advanced RAG**: Study LlamaIndex's advanced features like query routing, knowledge graphs, and custom retrievers. Understand how to optimize retrieval for Text-to-SQL systems and improve token efficiency.
3.  **Text-to-SQL RAG Systems**: Practice explaining the end-to-end architecture of a Text-to-SQL RAG engine. Be ready to discuss schema understanding, SQL query generation, optimization, and self-healing/refinement mechanisms when queries fail.
4.  **FastAPI and Python Backend Development**: Since FastAPI is a key JD requirement, ensure you can discuss building production-grade APIs, handling async operations, and integrating with LLM services and databases.
5.  **OpenAI API Advanced Usage**: Go beyond basic completions. Be prepared to discuss function calling, tool use, custom prompting strategies for domain-specific tasks (like finance), and cost/latency optimization techniques.
6.  **System Design for AI Pipelines**: Be ready to whiteboard the design of a scalable, fault-tolerant document processing or agentic chatbot system, covering data ingestion, processing, storage, and API layers.

Study these topics thoroughly, as the technical interview will likely probe your hands-on experience and architectural decisions in these specific domains.

cover_letter.objective: Senior AI & Full Stack Developer with over 4 years of specialized experience in architecting and deploying intelligent agentic workflows using LangGraph and LlamaIndex. Proven expertise in building high-performance Text-to-SQL RAG search systems, designing token-efficient LLM pipelines with OpenAI APIs, and developing scalable backend services with Python and FastAPI. Passionate about engineering end-to-end AI solutions that bridge advanced data processing with robust, production-ready full-stack applications.
